where.if: AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, nickname, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_key FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{uid}
SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{uid} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
